sections.sectionTitle: Paper 1: Written Comprehension and Grammar Structure

subtopics.content: Written passage comprehension, parts of speech, verb tenses/moods, agreement, pronouns, adverbs, sentence patterns, direct/reported speech, figures of speech
subtopics.objective: Read and answer multiple-choice questions on standard written French passages[cite: 313]; apply correct grammatical usage including articles, nouns, adjectives, pronouns, regular/irregular verbs, tenses, negation, adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions, active/passive voice, direct/reported speech, and common idiomatic expressions[cite: 315, 316].

subtopics.content: Free essay writing on general themes and formal/informal letter writing
subtopics.objective: Write coherent compositions of about 100 words using correct vocabulary, registers, and grammatical structures for general essays and formal/informal correspondence[cite: 314].

sections.sectionTitle: Paper 3: Oral Test (Listening, Reading Aloud & Conversation)

topics.title: Listening Comprehension, Reading Aloud, Dialogue, and Exposition

subtopics.content: Listening passage comprehension, reading aloud with proper pronunciation/fluency, dialogue interaction, and theme exposition
subtopics.objective: Listen to a spoken passage and answer comprehension, transformation, or substitution questions[cite: 314]; read aloud contemporary French passages with appropriate speed, intonation, and pronunciation[cite: 314]; engage in conversational dialogue responding to questions (including literature questions where applicable)[cite: 315]; speak fluently on given contemporary themes in an exposition[cite: 315].
